integrity: The proof reconstructs the chain specialization directly from the published signed-filter definition, independently derives all simplex facets, uses a positive facet-normal dependence for the exact inradius, solves perpendicular-bisector recurrences for the enclosing center, and certifies global minimum-enclosing optimality from center membership in the polytope. Finite symbolic replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the enriched order polytope of a chain in its canonical coordinate realization. It does not provide Euclidean radius formulas for arbitrary enriched order polytopes, and Euclidean radii are not invariant under general unimodular equivalence. The formulas are elementary after the chain simplex and its facets are isolated.
title: Enriched-order chain simplices have exact Euclidean in- and enclosing radii
